entries.mem0ai/mem0: This official Hermes Agent memory provider offers a universal memory layer with multi-level support for user, session, and agent states. It features temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval, available as an Apache-2.0 self-hosted server or a managed cloud service.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight provides long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows for agents, supporting over 25 LLM providers including local models. It offers flexible deployment via Docker, Kubernetes, or managed cloud with client libraries for Python, Node.js, and Go.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking is an AGPL-3.0 context database that organizes agent data as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs. As an official Hermes provider, it utilizes a three-tier loading system to achieve significant token reduction and task-completion gains.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: This open-source platform enables persistent long-term memory through a self-hosted knowledge graph engine that builds searchable structures from text, code, and conversations. It is designed to run locally on CPU without requiring external LLM API keys.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes provider, Supermemory features a custom vector graph engine capable of sub-300ms recall at scales exceeding 100B tokens per month. It supports multi-modal extraction and maintains auto-updated user profiles with stable facts and recent activity.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This opinionated agent brain stores facts with provenance and allows for corrections or withdrawals of stored information. It exposes memory to agents via MCP on Tailscale tailnets and requires Bun 1.4.0 for installation.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: Honcho is a memory library for building stateful agents, serving as the upstream foundation for the honcho-self-hosted Hermes wrapper. It is implemented as a FastAPI server with SDKs for Python and TypeScript, supporting managed and local Docker deployments.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: This official Hermes provider treats memory as a git repository, offering version control features like commit, branch, and merge for markdown context trees. It utilizes a 5-tier retrieval system to achieve sub-100ms performance across 20 supported LLM providers.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Mnemosyne is a zero-dependency memory system for Hermes Agents that requires only Python 3.10 and a single SQLite database. It features episodic compression to manage storage growth and supports integrations with MCP and OpenWebUI.
entries.moorcheh-ai/memanto: Memanto reconciles conflicting information by superseding old knowledge with new facts and exports data to the Open Knowledge Format for portability. It is designed for privacy, capable of running locally with no outbound calls in on-prem mode.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer memory system for Hermes Agent utilizes Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite to manage structured facts and vector search. It employs a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize injected context during recall.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: Autocontext is a recursive self-improving harness that generates playbooks and training artifacts from task runs to assist agents with complex objectives. It supports various endpoints including Anthropic and self-hosted vLLM, accessible via CLI or MCP server.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This plugin utilizes a SQLite-backed hierarchical DAG to ensure message persistence without data loss. It provides specialized recall tools like lcm_grep and lcm_recall to help Hermes Agent recover specific details from its context history.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: This tool indexes session history from 35 supported coding agents directly from local disk without requiring models or cloud servers. It allows users to search through months of past sessions and synchronize that history between machines via SSH.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: Honcho provides a private, self-hosted memory backend for Hermes Agent that enables cross-session persistence using Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis. It is compatible with any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider or local inference servers.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet-AI offers a local-first identity and memory layer that maintains portable state across Hermes Agent and other MCP clients. It supports real-time data ingestion from Obsidian, Discord, and GitHub, achieving high accuracy on LongMemEval benchmarks.
entries.plur-ai/plur: This shared memory layer uses a human-readable YAML engram format to store context on local disk for multi-agent systems. It facilitates shared context across various coding agents using local-first retrieval methods like BGE-small.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is a local-only context engine that operates without cloud dependencies or API keys. It employs hybrid retrieval through BM25, vector search, and multi-graph traversal, integrating via MCP servers and agent plugins.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: This file-based memory system uses a five-tier hierarchical SQLite schema and FTS5 search instead of vector databases or embeddings. It is delivered as a five-package plugin family that includes a dedicated Hermes adapter and CLI.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: ContextPilot optimizes long-context inference for Hermes Agent by reordering text and multimodal context to improve prefix-cache sharing. It features a context index for deduplication and cache-aware scheduling across engines like vLLM and llama.cpp.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This embedded plugin provides explainable retrieval by tagging every recalled item with a reason for its selection. It manages memory health by tracking contradictions and conflicts while using recency ranking for results.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn uses an Obsidian vault as a source of truth, storing durable memory as inspectable Markdown files with frontmatter metadata. It utilizes a local DuckDB cache for hybrid search to provide cross-project memory for coding agents.
entries.JanYork/llm-wiki-cli: This CLI tool enables agents to autonomously maintain persistent knowledge across sessions using local SQLite and Wiki files. It also supports team synchronization through a self-hosted server with built-in permission controls.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: Flowstate-qmd implements anticipatory memory by watching session logs to prefetch context via RAG and vector search. It is a local-first MCP server that uses SQLite-vec and GGUF models to support major coding agent clients.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack serves as a memory kernel stack that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single memory owner. It utilizes SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide agents with purpose-built evidence packets for each query.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This reflective memory system combines semantic search with BM25 full-text indexing and ranked graph traversal. It features automated indexing for multimedia and codebases, using edge tags to establish navigable, bidirectional relationships between notes.
entries.aliasocracy/hermes-tool-slimmer: This middleware reduces tool schema token overhead for Hermes version 0.19+ through local keyword-based ranking. It includes a dedicated dashboard for managing tool configurations and monitoring token savings.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-context-os: This Git-backed context layer provides durable Markdown-based decision logs and context for coding agents like Claude Code and Codex. It requires manual review for integration enablement and all context updates.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes a single .lbdb embedded graph database to surface high-priority memories via 1-10 importance ranking. It supports BM25 keyword search and optional GLiNER2 entity extraction for named graph relationships.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This episodic memory plugin features an on-demand summarizer and supports immediate event deletion to prevent persistent summaries from affecting future recall. It provides a trace.jsonl audit log to track every prefetch and memory operation.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes local skills, scripts, runbooks, and MCP server configurations for agent routing. It uses session hooks to deliver concise system-prompt hints and provides five native tools for artifact retrieval.
entries.piprail/piprail: Piprail provides a TypeScript SDK and MCP server that enables agents to handle x402 payments using USDC and stablecoins across multiple chain families. The system operates without a backend, database, or API keys for budget-bound wallets.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: XMemo enables cross-agent continuity by allowing agents to read memories from other connected instances. It uses native lifecycle hooks for session snapshots and a local SQLite layer to ensure write outbox reliability.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 to provide self-organizing long-term memory for agents. It supports manual memory storage and offers configurable query expansion and result reranking for retrieval.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private local code memory for repositories through deterministic slash commands and LLM-callable tools. It requires a local SourceVault server to handle indexing, vector storage, and grounded Q&A.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: MongrelDB offers AI-native long-term memory with AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and MinHash deduplication. It supports HNSW ANN, sparse, and FM-index retrieval via native Rust FFI or an HTTP daemon.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 specialized tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal, utilizing a hybrid search approach that integrates BM25, vector, and graph methods. It ensures continuity during message compression by implementing automatic context checkpointing to preserve relevant information.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: Focusing on memory hygiene, this tool uses a file-based loop to identify stale data and contradictions within plain markdown files. It generates evidence-cited JSON diffs for manual review and leverages a local git repository to track or revert changes without requiring a database.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework implements a software development methodology centered on TDD, YAGNI, and DRY principles. It automates technical planning and specification elicitation while integrating with various coding harnesses and CLI tools.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first system for design and prototyping that supports the generation of web prototypes, motion graphics, and slides. It features native runtime support for the DeepSeek Harness agent and integrates with tools like Claude Code and GitHub Copilot.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This library provides 818 structured skills across 34 security domains, mapped to frameworks including MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF 2.0, and ATLAS. It is compatible with over 26 AI platforms to support standardized security operations.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill converts codebases, infrastructure-as-code, and schemas into draw.io diagrams using natural language descriptions. It supports incremental synchronization to preserve manual layouts and includes an optional MCP server.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Serving as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this tool manages natural-language mandates, ERC-7710 permissions, and x402 payments. It includes a master router and connector skills to facilitate escrow and dispute resolution.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI patterns using professional, technical, or casual voice profiles. It offers detect-only and edit-in-place modes for agents like Claude Code and Hermes.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This agentic evolver automates the deduplication and quality improvement of skill libraries through background evolution. It unifies libraries across devices and team members, integrating with Hermes, Codex, and OpenAI-compatible APIs.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library featuring 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills compatible with agent-plugins.org specifications. It maintains session state locally within a project's documentation folder.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection contains 1,176 markdown-based skills across 35 professions that run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code. The library operates without telemetry or mandatory user accounts and provides exports for other assistants.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This plugin enables Hermes Agent and other tools to perform video searches, browse channels, and extract transcripts or playlists. It requires a TranscriptAPI key and is compatible with OpenClaw, Cursor, and Windsurf.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable skill patterns. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python scaffolds, which can be managed via slash commands.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: These skills enable Hermes Agent to generate its own custom thinking instructions and analytical lenses for specific tasks. The system provides a report of findings alongside an analysis of potential blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project provides type-safe support for remote skill registries using Git and S3 sources. It enables agents to read bundled resources and execute scripts within a sandboxed environment to isolate untrusted code from the host.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill implements literate programming by weaving prose, diagrams, and source code into .lit.md files. It features a tangler to extract runnable files and automatically synchronizes source edits back into the original documentation.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This workflow transforms rough concepts into structured design and implementation documents through specialized Lite and Full modes. It ensures quality control by utilizing a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Maestro serves as a harness for long-running agents, utilizing a mechanism kernel for SQLite storage and event logging. It coordinates agent teams via the SLP protocol and distributes prompt-first working methods as Markdown recipes.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin facilitates cross-instance shared memory through markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It establishes a pipeline for fine-tuning and transitioning tasks to replacement models.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community resource provides a registry of Portuguese-language skills and guides for VPS deployment and MCP integration. It supports skill installation through a dedicated CLI tap or direct raw URLs.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Built on the Agent Skills specification, this project enables interactions with oracle networks and smart contracts. It supports specific integrations for CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds, with installation managed via the Vercel CLI.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: These official skills provide API integration for FLUX image and video generation, including support for polling and webhooks. The suite includes eight specialist skills specifically designed for the FLUX 3 video ecosystem.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts code repositories and developer discourse into verified instruction files compliant with the agentskills.io spec. It maps instructions to specific source lines and includes automated workflows for testing and exporting skills.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika is a local-first workflow language that converts plain-text job descriptions into .nika files using a Rust binary. It audits costs and tool permissions before execution and generates hash-chained records to verify run integrity.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry offers reusable AI skills that can be installed with recursive dependency resolution via a Python client or CLI. It also incorporates commerce features by supporting payments through the TON network.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill manages complex multi-step tasks with autonomous execution and real-time progress tracking. It ensures operational safety through built-in rollback procedures and checkpoints for task recovery.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication via HTTPS using Nextcloud App Passwords and includes a guided setup script for credential validation.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: Serving as a community hub for skill discovery and one-click installation, this project implements the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and features federated search integration with GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This project provides a five-layer intelligent retrieval system that uses hard triggers and semantic embeddings to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. By reducing token usage and offering graceful degradation when dependencies are missing, it optimizes how agents locate relevant capabilities.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during tool discovery. It employs a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and incrementally discovers server metadata and tool schemas.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Designed as an ADHD-friendly personal execution system, this project uses MCP connections for agent-driven scheduling and habit management. It stores all data locally in a single SQLite file and provides interfaces via a React web app and an Expo-based Android application.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin optimizes agent communication by rewriting and scoring prompts across multiple surfaces like Discord, Telegram, and CLI. It supports 97 languages and claims to reduce token usage by 20–80% per rewrite based on five quality dimensions.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: Hermaguard provides adversarial code review by employing three parallel subagents to identify edge cases and integration issues. It combines deterministic pre-scans using tools like Semgrep and Bandit with verified findings through proof-of-concept execution in a hardened sandbox.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill uses a multi-agent swarm to improve code hygiene, clarity, and correctness across five programming languages. It features a tiered application process that includes an approval gate for managing simplification risks.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project adapts verified procedures for task decomposition, evidence-based gating, and systematic investigation protocols. It includes a Python goal engine for persistent state management to prevent early-stop errors during complex debugging.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey cybersecurity lab equips Hermes Agent with over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for forensics, network analysis, and exploitation. It integrates 28 cybersecurity frameworks and standards to facilitate CVE-driven security tasks.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern enables tool-based skill loading via Microsoft.Extensions.AI. It supports automatic registration of skill directories and utilizes SKILL.md files for progressive disclosure of capabilities.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This collection provides production-tested markdown files that teach agents specific procedures for session management, worktree recovery, and PR reviews. It is designed for installation across various environments including Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: This local-first dashboard provides real-time observability for Hermes Agent, tracking token costs, session history, and skill analytics. It ensures data privacy through read-only access and local log desensitization while supporting optional incident alerts via Telegram and Feishu.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill enables agents to generate reproducible demo GIFs for repositories using vhs or Playwright recording scripts. It optimizes output files to stay under 8 MB and supports a variety of interfaces including terminal CLIs, TUIs, and web applications.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This tool allows agents to search a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 skills directly from the terminal. It provides installation commands for discovered plugins and integrates with MCP-compatible clients like Hermes, Cursor, and Claude Code.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This host-agnostic framework creates a self-improvement loop by analyzing session history to identify and propose new skill coverage gaps. It gates all updates behind deterministic and LLM-judge evaluators to ensure quality before auto-applying improvements.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This utility generates portable agent skills and Claude Code extensions while preventing specification rot through weekly monitoring of official frontmatter. It includes a validator with CI-friendly exit codes to detect field drift against runtime-specific profiles.
entries.superagnt/leverage: This collection provides skills for social data, CRM management, and lead enrichment for agentskills.io compliant clients. It includes an MCP server that facilitates browser-based OAuth authentication and workspace Postgres integration.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This suite offers specialized tools for transcribing Douyin videos into Markdown, extracting structured data via macOS Vision OCR, and removing common Chinese AI writing patterns. It is designed for e-commerce material processing and document digitization.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: This project enables deterministic path routing and Python runtime selection across Windows, Git Bash/MSYS, and WSL environments. It allows agents to verify project-compatible interpreters and handle file operations using environment-specific syntax.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates USDC payments for HTTP 402 responses using protocols such as Pay Link, x402, and MPP. It is compatible with the OpenClaw and Hermes Agent standards for handling paid API interactions.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This project certifies the quality of AI agent skills by testing their structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It issues cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures to confirm a skill actually works.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin allows users to earn or distribute USDC on the Base network by answering support bounties via the x402 protocol. It facilitates the entire workflow from listing bounties and buying context to submitting drafts for human approval.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This integration exposes 191 tools and five production-grade workflow skills to Hermes Agent via a hosted MCP server. It enables agents to access structured web data across 31 different platforms.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill enables Hermes Agent to generate multi-scale Chinese news briefings ranging from global events to street-level updates. It produces structured reports featuring core conclusions and action suggestions while utilizing semantic memory to align search expansions with specific user interests.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides daily-updated Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes, across terminal, desktop, and IDE environments. It is included for users seeking a package-managed approach to development tools on Nix-supported systems.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone offers an automated installer and configuration guides for running the Antigravity CLI and OpenClaw on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It enables mobile deployment by leveraging Termux:API and Termux:GUI for hardware and interface access.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a Termux-based automated installation script that utilizes proot-distro Ubuntu to run Hermes Agent on Android. It supports interactive model setup, shell command execution, and connectivity with both local Ollama models and external providers.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates Kubernetes deployments by enforcing single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows with configurable gateway, API, and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: Providing a one-command installer for both Android (Termux) and iOS (iSH), this project brings the Hermes AI assistant to mobile platforms. It distinguishes itself by integrating Telegram for voice and file messaging alongside support for scheduled cron jobs.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw provides a sandboxed environment for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell for hardware-enforced security. It implements kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access while allowing for configurable security policies regarding web searches and messaging.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane for deploying and operating Hermes agents on Docker and Kubernetes via Helm charts. It features a 69-entry credential catalog, support for over 17 LLM providers, and mandatory AES-256-GCM encryption for all secrets.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a Docker sandbox image that combines the official Hermes installation with mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted directories and allows users to target specific Hermes versions using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module enables reproducible deployments through declarative configuration of workspace documents and settings. It offers a hybrid management system for skills and integrates with sops-nix for secure secrets handling via systemd.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first control plane designed to orchestrate multiple agent instances with distinct identities and workspaces from a single web application. It manages granular permissions for tools and networks while providing dedicated Telegram and WhatsApp communication channels.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: Targeting headless Ubuntu and Debian environments, this project configures the Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service. It is designed for production-ready autonomous execution of recurring AI tasks via cron jobs.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable distribution that runs from USB drives without requiring host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools to support Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in offline or isolated environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework deploys specialized agents to perform fundamental, sentiment, and technical financial analysis. It features a research team that debates bullish and bearish perspectives and supports backtesting with SEC EDGAR integration and point-in-time data integrity.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform governs agent registration, task dispatching, memory browsing, and cost tracking. Users can manage multi-agent workflows through a Web UI, CLI, or MCP server, with support for local Node.js or Docker deployments.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This control surface manages multiple coding agents, including Hermes Agent, using tmux for persistent background execution. It provides TUI and web-based dashboards with diff review capabilities and supports sandboxing via Docker, Podman, and Apple Containers.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: Designed for scaling Hermes Agent from single instances to automated teams, this template utilizes a level-based architecture and a task bus pattern for delegation. It includes bundled skills for VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework enables the construction of autonomous agent swarms across 23+ LLM providers, including OpenAI and Ollama. It features durable agent memory, MCP tool integration, and visual org charts to manage agent team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This platform provides a centralized screen for supervising autonomous Hermes Agent work through a Kanban board and live streaming of agent reasoning. It requires human-in-the-loop verification for all agent-proposed task completions to ensure oversight.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This project coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure roles. It utilizes a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for precise routing and coordination.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local collaboration system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents using Hermes Agent profiles and the MCP and ACP protocols. It features a real-time Web UI for monitoring agent dialogues and managing task lifecycles via a Kanban flow.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code for Hermes Agent. It orchestrates evaluations for TBLite and TerminalBench-2 while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents across two competing AI companies to vie for GitHub stars. Using Paperclip and Hermes Agent for execution, the system visualizes agent tasks and scoreboard metrics on a real-time dashboard.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This fully-local framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack optimized for consumer GPUs like the RTX 4080/5080. It uses Hermes for task routing and tool-calling, utilizing parallel model querying and synthesis without cloud dependencies.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, Rust-powered code knowledge graph that reduces token usage and tool calls for Hermes Agent. It features a built-in MCP server and auto-syncs the index on every file change to maintain up-to-date context.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale is a CLI tool that tracks token usage across multiple AI coding agents, including Hermes, through a terminal UI and 3D visualization dashboard. It allows users to monitor their consumption and submit data to public leaderboards and profiles.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer enables developers to inspect API traffic from Hermes Agent and other coding tools while redacting authentication headers for security. It exports trace sessions into self-contained HTML files for detailed analysis of agent interactions.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time tracking of tokens, costs, and rate limits by reading Hermes Agent state directly. It supports multi-device synchronization and offers detailed usage breakdowns by model, session, and project.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI offers design systems and layout guidance to Hermes Agent via MCP servers to improve UI construction. It is compatible with any AI provider supporting markdown and integrates directly into the agent's workflow.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This opinionated workflow layer adds 36 skills and 6 specialized workflows to Hermes Agent, coordinating seven agent roles through a CTO loop. It automates the entire lifecycle of an application, from building and deployment to health checks and log observation.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: Hermes-skins allows users to customize the Hermes terminal UI with YAML-based themes, including retro DOS and cyberpunk aesthetics. The tool modifies visual elements such as banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel is an AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control, featuring a supervisor sidebar for managing Hermes Agent approvals and checkpoints. It supports external MCP clients and browser automation workflows across various AI providers.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform establishes a social economy for autonomous agents by providing encrypted messaging via the Signal Protocol and human-readable @handles. It enables Hermes Agent to participate in commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This project ports the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to run natively within the Claude Code Channel without external processes or OAuth. It includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and reinforcement learning training.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: Lintlang is a static linter that evaluates AI agent configurations and system prompts using HERM v1.1 scoring. It identifies ambiguous tool overlaps and missing progress conditions, generating SARIF or JSON reports for CI integration.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides memory integrations for various frameworks using a two-tier system of knowledge graphs and session caches. It supports chat platforms like Slack and Telegram, extending the persistent memory capabilities available to agents.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings during agent operations. It includes over 40 pre-configured skills for finance, devops, and research, supported by automated installation for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: Ankh.md is a TAW Agent framework that enables per-folder scoping for Hermes Agents, allowing for project-local memories and custom instructions. It facilitates seamless switching between default and scoped agents based on the local configuration and skills defined within a directory.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of the hermes-agent stack and 12 supporting services across three scalable deployment tiers. It provides immediate access to 29 community plugins and supports free models to ensure a zero-cost production environment.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility transitions users from OpenClaw to Hermes Agent by mapping SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, and skills into compatible YAML and JSON formats. It also configures systemd gateway services and handles the conversion of nested authentication structures.
entries.observeco/observeco: Observeco provides self-healing observability for multi-agent systems through a native Hermes plugin that exports real-time telemetry without cloud dependencies. It uses config-aware baselines to detect performance drift and offers both passive zero-token analysis and active probing.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: Designed for local runtime by default, this project focuses on secure task execution by requiring explicit approval for all external writes and consequential actions. It includes specific contracts for managing opportunities and offer-previews to help users generate income using Hermes Agent.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This voice-enabled assistant adds offline, wake-word capabilities to Hermes Agent without requiring API keys or accounts. It supports 35 languages and features adaptive turn-taking, allowing users to interact with their agent through a fully local voice interface.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This memory plugin for Hermes supports multi-dimensional storage and semantic search for managing agent information. It includes a built-in circuit breaker to handle MemOS API outages while providing tools to search, add, and delete memories.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager for Windows, macOS, and Linux provides a centralized interface for Hermes Agent and other CLI tools. It eliminates the need for manual editing of JSON, TOML, and YAML files by managing MCP, skills, and prompts in one location.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local cowork application that supports autonomous multi-step tasks with user approval and file access for Hermes Agent. It features built-in assistants for generating editable office documents and enables 24/7 unattended automation via cron and remote access interfaces.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: This web-based interface offers 1:1 parity with the Hermes CLI experience for use on browsers and mobile devices. Built with Python and vanilla JavaScript, it utilizes a three-panel layout to organize sessions, chat, and file browsing.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion app provides guided installation and dependency resolution for Hermes Agent. It includes a GUI for chat, session management, and tool configuration, supporting various AI providers including OpenAI, Anthropic, and local endpoints.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio: Ekko-studio is a web dashboard that enables visual workflows with schedules and human approval gates across ten platforms like Telegram and Discord. It provides unified configuration and usage analytics for tracking token breakdown and costs.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers. It integrates a memory browser, skills manager, and MCP catalog alongside a Monaco-based file browser and PTY terminal.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative coding workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes and other agents into a desktop app, standalone server, or Docker container. It supports fifteen built-in agents and offers native iOS and Android clients for remote access.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: This native Mac workspace provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts. It includes an embedded terminal for shell access and system repair, plus native views for managing sessions, Kanban boards, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first desktop app features a built-in kernel with health check and update capabilities. The UI supports chat, memory management, and rendering for LaTeX and Markdown.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects the active browser context to local gateways, Hermes Cloud, or remote APIs. It includes tools for tab triage and page commenting, providing site-aware drafting assistance across 31 recognized writing environments.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI iPhone app designed to drive self-hosted Hermes agents by pairing with a hermes-webui server. It requires iOS 18+ and allows users to manage tasks, skills, and workspace files with real-time chat streaming.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: Wesight is a desktop workspace offering one-click setup for Hermes Agent and other engines with custom LLM model routing. It includes a runtime dashboard for tracking token usage and latency while monitoring live code writes and diffs.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This interactive TUI serves as a consciousness monitor for Hermes, featuring nine tabs and four selectable color themes. It provides a tmux operator view for managing live agent panes while tracking agent growth, git projects, and scheduled cron jobs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard offers a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and system metrics behind a secure login. It includes an MCP server control plane for lifecycle management and a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser and cockpit that tracks per-session quota burn and API costs for models like Codex and Claude. It builds local search indexes to query prompts, tool calls, and errors across 16 different agent formats without uploading history.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS workspace facilitates one-click automated Hermes Agent installations on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It features an integrated WebRTC voice mode utilizing OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP for communication.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and Tailwind CSS v4, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It specifically features an approval inbox for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: Built with OpenTUI, this alternative interface provides a terminal-based environment for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It supports profile and skill management alongside a kanban board for tracking agentic work and tasks.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This React-based mobile UI allows users to run up to five concurrent background agent instances within a Telegram Mini App. It supports terminal chat with streaming responses and file attachments, secured by HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This portable Windows desktop application requires no installation or admin rights, running via self-contained Python and Node.js environments. It includes a workflow engine and 100 tools for tasks such as TTS, music generation, and ComfyUI image creation.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: This glassmorphic web interface provides real-time log streaming and a file browser for self-hosted AI assistants. It includes a task tracking dashboard and management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This dashboard focuses on process monitoring, offering real-time session activity and cost tracking. It allows for full inspection of conversation histories and skill source code, alongside read-only monitoring of environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A self-hosted workspace featuring real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards for agent interactions. It includes an integrated marketplace for skills and MCP servers, plus isolated profile management for separate sessions and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This desktop client orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents through a central PM orchestrator. It features a Visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and supports model switching with streaming SSE responses.
